text:
maya (Finance): Heads up — CuraTech invoice INV-2026-1198 shows the Private Deployment platform fee billed twice due to a migration overlap. Need guidance on issuing a pro-rated credit and correcting support tier mapping.

maya (Finance): Invoice snippet: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-1198
Lines:
- Private Deployment Platform Fee: $60,000
- Private Support (Premium): $12,000
- Dedicated Platform Fee (overlap duplicate): $60,000
- Concurrency add-on: $4,000
Total: $136,000
```

lucas (Customer Success): I confirmed with the customer — migration completed in their window. They moved from Dedicated -> Private. Migration window was 2025-12-15 to 2025-12-20. They expected proration, not two full platform fees :grimacing:

sam (Account Exec): Sales note: we have a signed migration addendum effective 2025-12-15. Customer expectation was explicit about proration on switchover.

kevin (Onprem Ops): Checked infra logs — deprovision event for the Dedicated cluster at 2025-12-20T02:14Z. Billing ingestion ran on 2025-12-20 and again on 2025-12-21 and picked up duplicated resource IDs. Looks like a metering dedupe failure.

maya (Finance): Proposed fix: 1) Issue a pro-rated credit for the overlap (6 days) on the duplicated platform fee (~$27,500) 2) Re-issue corrected invoice removing duplicate line 3) Create eng ticket to dedupe ingestion and prevent recurrence. Seeking approval to proceed with credit memo and to repo the corrected invoice to CuraTech.

tara (Legal): Pull and attach the signed addendum + SOW clause about billing during migration before we finalize credit. If the contract is clear we should be safe to credit. If ambiguous, advise a documented good-faith credit and a customer acceptance note.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-1198 ingestion flagged: duplicate_resource_ids. Auto-ticket created: INC-7632.

ana (Finance Lead): approve up to $30,000 one-time credit for customer goodwill and to correct billing. Condition: get customer sign-off on corrected invoice and retain a signed acceptance email in the account file. Tag me on the final.

maya (Finance): Thanks Ana — will prepare credit memo draft and updated invoice. Kevin, can you open/assign the eng ticket and provide ETA?

kevin (Onprem Ops): Assigned INC-7632 -> ENG-1129 and pinged eng-infra. ETA to root-cause + patch: EOD tomorrow.

lucas (Customer Success): I'll collect customer confirmation that proration is acceptable and will send back a signed acceptance once they approve the corrected invoice.

maya (Finance): I'll queue the credit memo in accounting and hold issuance until we have the signed acceptance. Will tag @ana when ready. :thumbsup:

sam (Account Exec): Noted. I'll prep the customer-facing note and cc legal.

maya (Finance): Final ask — approval thumbs? Ana already approved up to $30k. If no objections from Legal/Ops, we'll proceed once signed acceptance arrives.

tara (Legal): No objections from Legal pending we capture the signed acceptance.

maya (Finance): Great — closing loop here. I'll update INC-7632 with the invoice correction steps and post the credit memo when issued.
